simple.summary: כׇּל־חֹזֶה (Kol-Chôzeh) means Col-Chozeh , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Neh 3 15.

definitions.full: H3626. Kol -chozeh כָּלחֹֿזֶה proper name, masculine 1. father of one of the builders, Shallun Neh 3:15 . 2 a name in Judah Neh 11:5 (relation to 1 unknown). כִּלָּיוֺן כְּלִי, , etc., see below I. כלה . כִּלְיָה see below II. כלה .
